title: Taczlevel
description: New enhancement schemes have been added for tacz firearms. The front mod requires TaczAttributeAdd, KubeJS, Timeless and Classics Zero.为tacz枪械增加了新的强化方案，前置mod需要TaczAttributeAdd，KubeJS，Timeless and Classics Zero。
body: This mod has added two blocks, namely Create a gun upgrade platform and a gun upgrade platform. The gun upgrade platform can consume one Lower Star (the consumed items can be changed through configuration) to enable an upgrade option for the firearms in the tacz module. Once enabled, this option must reach level 50 before other upgrade options can be activated. The creation of the gun upgrade platform is unrestricted and all upgrade options can be activated at level 1 without consuming items. There are four upgrade options, namely reloading speed, armor penetration, reducing recoil, and firing rate. The upper limit of the bonus level, the bonus for each level, and the maximum bonus upper limit can be changed through configuration. After enabling the upgrade option, you can gain experience to level up by dealing damage, killing animals, neutral creatures, and hostile creatures. Front modules: TaczAttributeAdd, KubeJS, Timeless and Classics Zero.该模组添加了两个方块，分别是创造枪械升级台，枪械升级台。枪械升级台可以消耗一个下界之星（可通过配置更改消耗的物品）为tacz模组的枪械开启一项升级选项，开启后该选项达到50级才可以继续激活其他升级选项，创造枪械升级台不受限并且可以在1级时就开启所有升级选项并且不消耗物品。升级选项有4个，分别是换弹速度，护甲穿透，减小后坐力，射速。可通过配置更改加成等级上限，每级的加成，最大加成上限。开启升级选项后可通过造成伤害，击杀动物，中立生物，敌对生物来获取经验提升等级。前置模组：TaczAttributeAdd，KubeJS，Timeless and Classics Zero。
